detail.longDescription: Web-based email is fine, but nothing quite comes close to the convenience of a native email client. It's the best way to manage multiple accounts, access messages offline, and make use of powerful tools that can help quickly triage your inbox. And there's no shortage of Windows email clients that can boost your email productivity.
